Commentary.Commentary: We are back for India's second innngs. The England players are out in the middle. Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill will open the innings for India. Olly Stone will start the proceedings for England.

So, India have a more than decent lead already. What approach will they opt for with the bat? The England spinners will get assistance off the surface as well. So, it is not going to be easy for the Indians as well. A couple of early strikes and England will look to push the Indians on the back foot a bit. The second innings of Indian batting coming your way shortly.

Foakes along with Leach walked out to resume the session. The duo kept the Indians at bay and made sure England went past the follow-on target. However, Ishant returned with the ball and struck in his first over to dismiss Leach and Broad lasted just 2 balls as Ashwin bagged yet another fifer to close the innings. Foakes worked hard and played nicely, playing his first-ever Test on Indian soil. And like the Indian keeper Pant, he too remained unbeaten.
Ashwin leads the Indian unit out of the park! What a performance from him. And he has helped India take a massive lead of 195 runs. Fantastic bowling from the Indians overall.

OUT! TIMBER! There you go! It's all over in this innings. Fifer for Ashwin! His 29th in Tests. Floated on middle, Broad gets down and looks to sweep. He fails to get under it and ends up getting an inside edge. The ball then hits his pad and goes onto the stumps. England are bowled out for 134.

Fine, fine catch and India just 1 away from bundling England away. A probing over from Ishant this one and he finally gets the reward.

We are back for the final session! The Indian players have taken their positions in the field. Ben Foakes walks out along with Jack Leach. Ashwin will finish the over. Just 1 shy of yet another fifer. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Right! India still 223 ahead and they just need 2 wickets to close the innings. England need 24 more to avoid the follow-on. Will they push Egland to bat again? They might fancy them, seeing the massive bite on the surface. We will soon find out. Join us for the final session in a short while.

Ashwin removed dangerous Stokes early in the session. Pope and Foakes then presented a bit of a fight. Then came Mohammed Siraj. Bowling for the first time on the Indian soil in this format and bagged a wicket, courtesy of a blinder from Pant behind the wicket. After that wicket, England lost the track again. Axar returned to get rid of Moeen and then Ashwin got better of Stone to push the opposition under massive pressure.
And with this wicket, it is TEA ON DAY 2. What a session for India once again. 4 wickets in this one and they have pushed England completely on the back foot.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gone this time. An easy catch for Sharma at mid-wicket. Ashwin has his 4th. He floats this around off and middle, Stone goes for the flick. It goes uppishly towards mid-wicket. A simple chance for Rohit there. England crumbling here.

Massive turn! That pitches outside off and spins in sharply after landing on the rough. Stone lets it go. It bounces extra. Pant somehow gets the glove in front of his face to push it away towards point. Well, well, replays later show that Stone was late on getting his bat away and it had hit his gloves.

The ball then balloons to the left side of Rahane. He lunges forward and takes a stunning catch. Number 7 falls now. Still 25 behind from avoiding the follow-on.
Axar Patel is back on. 15-3-29-1 are his figures so far.

We are back for the second sesssion of Day 2. The Indian players are out in the middle. Ben Stokes will be joined by Ollie Pope. Axar Patel will start the proceedings for this session.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Right! A fine session of play where England got the 4 wickets quickly but Indians responded superbly with the ball by dismissing the 4 opposition batsmen. And the second session is nicely set up now. Join us for the same in a short while.

Earlier in the day, Pant went after the bowlers and reached his half ton. However, he kept losing partners at the other end. Moeen struck in his first over of the day and struck twice. Stone did the same and got two wickets in his over to close the Indian innings to 329. Pant remained unbeaten on 58.

WOW! What a finish to the session. The Lunch for the Indians will be a lot tastier now. They removed the two England openers early. Ishant got the breakthrough in the first over while Ashwin struck to send Sibley packing. And then Axar got his debut wicket, the massive one of Root to force the visitors on the back foot. Ashwin got the wicket on the last ball before Lunch to end Lawrence's vigil with the willow. Overall, with the kind of total India have got and the way the ball is turning, one can say that India are well on top in this game.

The ball spins enough to take the inner half. It goes a little right of Gill at forward short leg. He snaffles the chance and the Indians celebrate! With this, it is LUNCH ON DAY 2.
